Claim 1 (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition, wherein the physiological monitor is configured to detect a physiological parameter and generate the alarm condition based on the detected physiological parameter; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, wherein the escalated alarm is distinct from the first alarm in at least one of intensity, frequency, or modality.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition detected by a physiological sensor; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and an escalation status indicating whether the alarm has been escalated; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, wherein the system further comprises a communication interface configured to transmit the alarm data to a remote station.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm.

Claim 19 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices when the alarm remains unacknowledged after a predetermined time interval.
